value.signature: fn generate (root : & Path , write : bool) -> Result < Vec < Finding > >

review.body: { let mut projections = Vec :: new () ; let mut namespaces = BTreeSet :: new () ; let mut numeric_input = None ; let input_root = root . join ("docs/inputs") ; let families = ["claim-obligations" , "harness-registry" , "linter-owners"] ; let mut inputs = Vec :: new () ; for entry in at (& input_root , fs :: read_dir (& input_root)) ? { let entry = at (& input_root , entry) ? ; let path = entry . path () ; if at (& path , entry . file_type ()) ? . is_symlink () { return Err (format ! ("symlink is not a document input: {}" , path . display ()) . into ()) ; } if families . iter () . any (| name | entry . file_name () == * name) { inputs . push (path . join ("schema.toml")) ; } else if at (& path , entry . file_type ()) ? . is_dir () { inputs . extend (files (& path) ?) ; } else { inputs . push (path) ; } } inputs . sort () ; for path in inputs { if path . extension () . is_none_or (| ext | ext != "toml") { return Err (format ! ("input carrier: expected TOML: {}" , path . display ()) . into ()) ; } let family = families . iter () . find (| name | path == input_root . join (name) . join ("schema.toml")) ; let mut dataset = if let Some (family) = family { let output = std :: process :: Command :: new ("python3") . arg ("-B") . arg (root . join ("ci/registry_fragments.py")) . arg (root) . arg (family) . output () ? ; if ! output . status . success () { return Err (format ! ("fragment loader: {}" , String :: from_utf8_lossy (& output . stderr)) . into ()) ; } envelope :: json (std :: str :: from_utf8 (& output . stdout) ?) ? } else { envelope :: input (& read (& path) ?) . map_err (| error | format ! ("{}: {error}" , path . display ())) ? } ; numbers :: project (& mut dataset) ? ; if dataset . namespace == numbers :: NAMESPACE { numeric_input = Some (dataset . clone ()) ; } if ! namespaces . insert (dataset . namespace . clone ()) { return Err (format ! ("duplicate dataset: {}" , dataset . namespace) . into ()) ; } let destination = root . join ("docs/datasets") . join (format ! ("{}.json" , dataset . namespace)) ; projections . push ((destination , envelope :: bytes (& dataset) ?)) ; } if let Some (dataset) = numeric_input { let carrier = projections . iter () . find (| (path , _) | { path . file_name () . is_some_and (| name | name == "org.peer-network.design.constants.json") }) . map (| (_ , bytes) | std :: str :: from_utf8 (bytes)) . transpose () ? ; let mut requested = BTreeSet :: new () ; for path in files (& root . join ("packages")) ? { if path . extension () . is_some_and (| extension | extension == "rs") { let source = read (& path) ? ; for rest in source . split ("DesignConstantId::") . skip (1) { let variant : String = rest . chars () . take_while (| letter | letter . is_ascii_alphanumeric () || * letter == '_') . collect () ; if ! variant . is_empty () { requested . insert (variant) ; } } } } let constants = numbers :: constants (carrier , & requested) ? ; projections . push ((root . join ("packages/documents/src/design_constants.rs") , constants . into_bytes () ,)) ; projections . extend (package_pins (root , & dataset) ?) ; } let expected : BTreeSet < _ > = projections . iter () . map (| (path , _) | path . clone ()) . collect () ; let mut findings = Vec :: new () ; for path in files (& root . join ("docs/datasets")) ? { if ! expected . contains (& path) { findings . push (Finding { kind : FindingKind :: OrphanDataset , path : relative (root , & path) ? , }) ; } } for (path , bytes) in projections { if compare (& path , & bytes , write) ? { findings . push (Finding { kind : FindingKind :: StaleDataset , path : relative (root , & path) ? , }) ; } } Ok (findings) }
review.item_premise: Only public committed inputs and their projected dataset bytes are consumed. Numeric pins read their registry carrier, and the typed design-floor accessor reads its validated projected expression by generated offsets without a second value literal or consumer-side parser dependency. Projection and generated source contain no secret carrier or new exposure boundary.
